risk_note: RV2 (orders/**, contracts, db/migrations, tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts). Admin manual order sync (01 F-ORD-10, 02 §7.1, CT-24n): POST / list / limits mounted on the admin entry with planned removed from the three operations (generated files regenerated); a window or order-number request, the same filter returning the original request (reused=true) while queued or running, windows split by the platform cap and dispatched to orders' order-sync queue with manual keys carrying sync_id, sync cursors neither read nor advanced, Pinduoduo by order numbers (Taobao / JD TODO blocked on CAP-TB-07 / CAP-JD-07), an empty status_filter registry, refusal while site auth is paused, the worker's offline breaker checked by the worker. Migration 0089 adds app.order_sync_request_windows (one row per window, CAS to done / failed with that window's counts; the request is done only when no window is unfinished; no foreign key to union_accounts per orchestrator ruling D10-353; no DELETE); lint-migrations funds and attribution list gains it (B1-09e precedent). The request body now declares each field once with the oneOf choosing only the mode (accepted values unchanged; orchestrator re-checked 14:33). Frozen [AC-CT-24n#1] block B (the three order-sync rows) expects them implemented, after the prerequisite split #1597 (D10-325 / #1585 precedent; D10-327). Implementation round 4 was an orchestrator exception (D10-353; the attempt counter stayed at 3). No money is written. Codex was unavailable until 10-30, so tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
